observations: Photo 0 shows a used car gearbox/transmission assembly on the ground with wiring/hoses attached; no clear make/model label visible.
Photo 1 shows the same gearbox/transmission from another angle; again no readable vehicle fitment (e.g., Rogue/Altima) or part number visible.

claims.claim: Direct tokunbo Japan highest grade Rogue and Altima gearbox
claims.evidence: Photos show a gearbox assembly but no readable label/part number/vehicle fitment confirming Nissan Rogue/Altima or 'tokunbo highest grade'.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (not actually for Nissan Rogue/Altima; could be another vehicle/gearbox type).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the gearbox ID plate/part number and the transmission type (e.g., pin count/gear code) plus the vehicle it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used gearbox with unknown fitment (worst case for buyer: may not bolt up / may be incompatible).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (photos don’t confirm it shifts/engages).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing it engages gears and no abnormal noise/leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as for parts/repair until tested).

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete harness/hoses (photos show attached wiring, but completeness can’t be confirmed).
risks.proof: Ask for a full inventory photo: all external sensors/solenoids, harness connectors, cooler lines, torque converter (if applicable), and any included accessories laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Transmission type mismatch (CVT vs automatic vs manual; internal differences affect compatibility and price).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the transmission tag plus a photo showing the transmission casing markings that indicate type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least certain type (worst case: assume buyer may receive a different transmission type than expected).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox ID plate/label (part number/gearbox code) and any markings that indicate Nissan Rogue/Altima fitment.
Video proof of working/test (engagement/shifting and no leaks/no abnormal sound).
Photos showing all included parts/accessories laid out (harness, sensors/solenoids, cooler lines, and any torque converter/related items if applicable).
Photo showing transmission type (CVT/AT/MT) from markings or tag.
response.reason: The photos show a used gearbox but do not provide readable identifiers to confirm the exact model/fitment (Rogue/Altima) or transmission type, and the seller’s working/grade claims are not verifiable remotely. Without the identifying tag/part number and test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the comparables.
